hook: Your phone camera turns a CD into a rainbow.
title: Your phone camera turns a CD into a rainbow
description:
Tilt any old CD or DVD in sunlight and look at it through your phone camera. The tiny tracks on the disc act as a diffraction grating and split light into a rainbow. Try it with any phone.

#Shorts #PhoneTricks #Science
comment_prompt: Did the rainbow show up? Yes or no

scenes.narration: Your phone camera turns a CD into rainbows.
scenes.headline: CD = RAINBOW
